test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Padma Bhushan awardee Kumudini Lakhia is renowned for which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Year 2024** list includes **5 Padma Vibhushan**, **17 Padma Bhushan** and **110 Padma Shri awards,**Among the 2024 award winners, **30 are also women**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kathak****​**

 
 
• It is a classical Indian dance form originating from the northern parts of India.
 
• It is known for its quick footwork, intricate spins, and expressive facial expressions.
 
• Kathak is traditionally performed by both men and women, and it often tells stories from Hindu mythology or depicts scenes from everyday life
 
• Roshan Kumari, Shovana Narayan, Maya Rao and** Kumudini Lakhia** are eminent kathak artists.
 
 
 
• ​Kumudini Lakhia
 
 
• ​Kumudini Lakhia, born on May 17, 1930, is an famous Indian Kathak dancer and choreographer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.
 
• She played a crucial role in reshaping the traditional solo form of Kathak, especially during the 1960s.
 
• Her famous choreographies include "Dhabkar", "Yugal", and "Atah Kim".
 
• She also contributed as a choreographer in the Hindi film "Umrao Jaan" (1981). ​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Odissi:-

 
 
• It is a classical Indian dance form originating from the state of Odisha in eastern India.
 
• It is known for its graceful and lyrical movements, intricate footwork, and expressive facial expressions.
 
• Odissi is traditionally performed by women, and it often tells stories from Hindu mythology or depicts scenes from everyday life.
 
• **Sujata Mohapatra, Madhavi Mudgal, Kelucharan Mohapatra, Surendra Nath Jena, Shobana Sahajananan** are eminent kathak artists.
 
 
 
• Kuchipudi:-
 
 
• It is a classical Indian dance form originating from the state of Andhra Pradesh in southern India. It is known for its energetic and vigorous movements, rhythmic footwork, and expressive hand gestures.
 
• Kuchipudi is traditionally performed by men, and it often tells stories from Hindu epics, such as the Ramayana and the Mahabharata.
 
• **Mallika Sarabhai, V. Satyanarayana Sarma, Deepa Shashindran** are eminent kathak artists.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam**
 
 
• Bharatanatyam originated in Tamil Nadu.
 
• Bharatanatyam is the oldest Indian classical dance and it originated hundreds of years ago in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu.
 
• This dance form expresses the religious themes and spiritual ideas of South India.
 
• The ancient Tamil epic Silappatikaram contains the description of Bharatanatyam.
 
• **​****Rukmini Devi, Padma Subrahmanyam, Vyjayanthimala, Sheema Kermani, Padmini** are eminent kathak artists.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi currently confers classical status on eight Indian classical dance styles:** Bharatanatyam** (Tamil Nadu), Kathak (North, West and Central India), Kathakali (Kerala), Kuchipudi (Andhra Pradesh), Odissi (Odissa), Manipuri (Manipur), Mohiniyattam (Kerala), and Sattriya (Assam).
